name: Aranessa Saltspite
canonNotes: Queen of Sartosa's pirates, rumoured daughter of Manann, who hunts Norscan wolf-ships with cold vengeance from her galleon Swordfysh.
Some say she was a Norscan mutant who cut off her own fishtail.
voiceNotes: Salty, fierce and direct; pirate talk, no patience for landlubber airs.
Loyal to her crew; merciless to Norscans.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
